inspection.contact_resizing: Aspect-preserving scaling with black letterbox; no forced source-to-output shape warp
columns: source index 123-i as diagnostic reverse reference

requested_edit.prompt: Reverse the temporal order of the entire reference clip: play all of its actions backward in time. Keep the same two people, their appearance, lighting, camera framing, and background.
requested_edit.expected_coarse_temporal_order: Start with the final close chest embrace, then move back toward face-to-face contact, and end at the initial separated-face pose with the man's hand against the woman's head.
requested_edit.diagnostic_scope: This explicitly asks for reversal; a text-only classifier can identify the requested temporal change. It is not a source-dependent VLM routing test.

observed_events.source_forward: They face each other with their faces separated; his hand rests against the side/back of her head and her arm reaches around his waist.
observed_events.A8: The same face-to-face separated-face pose is present, closely resembling source frame 0 rather than the final source embrace.
observed_events.reverse_reference: Source frame 123 is already a close chest embrace; her head rests against him and her face is turned toward the camera.
observed_events.order_evidence: A8 begins at the forward-source state, not at the required reverse-source endpoint.

observed_events.source_forward: They bring their faces together; by frame 30 a kissing/contact pose is visible while his hand remains against her head.
observed_events.A8: The same approach/contact progression is visible at the corresponding sampled times, including the kissing/contact pose in native frame 30.
observed_events.reverse_reference: Source frames 108 and 93 remain in the later chest-embrace phase.
observed_events.order_evidence: Early A8 remains consistent with forward progression and differs from the reversed-source reference.

observed_events.source_forward: The faces are apart again, before the woman's head settles against his chest.
observed_events.A8: The same separated-face transition appears at this sampled time.
observed_events.reverse_reference: Source frame 78 has already reached the chest-embrace state.
observed_events.order_evidence: A8 continues the forward sequence from face contact toward chest embrace.

observed_events.source_forward: She leans her head against his chest and the arm placement becomes a close embrace.
observed_events.A8: The same close embrace appears and continues.
observed_events.reverse_reference: Frame 63 is near the same middle state, so row 60 alone is ambiguous; by reverse row 75, source frame 48 is back toward the earlier face-to-face transition.
observed_events.order_evidence: The near-midpoint resemblance is not evidence of reversal; later samples separate the two directions.

observed_events.source_forward: The chest embrace continues; at the end her face turns toward the camera while remaining nestled against him.
observed_events.A8: The chest embrace also continues to the final frame, where her face turns toward the camera. Native frame 123 confirms this final state.
observed_events.reverse_reference: Source frames 33 and 18 return to the earlier face-contact phase and the final reversed reference is source frame 0 with separated faces.
observed_events.order_evidence: A8 ends at the forward-source ending rather than the required reversed-source ending.

temporal_edit_assessment.label: observed_global_reversal_failure_forward_source_order_preserved_at_sampled_times
temporal_edit_assessment.confidence_scope: Clear negative evidence for the requested whole-clip reversal, based on distinct initial/final poses and all nine sampled states; not a per-frame motion or pixel-equality measurement.
temporal_edit_assessment.A8_sequence_summary: face-to-face -> facial approach/contact -> faces apart -> close chest embrace -> continued embrace with face toward camera
temporal_edit_assessment.source_sequence_summary: face-to-face -> facial approach/contact -> faces apart -> close chest embrace -> continued embrace with face toward camera
temporal_edit_assessment.required_reverse_summary: final embrace -> reverse the transition out of the embrace -> earlier facial contact -> initial face-to-face state
not_claimed: No claim that A8 is pixel-identical to source.
No claim that every tiny motion between sampled frames is forward.
No claim of exact camera or spatial correspondence, because the input and output have different dimensions/aspect ratios and no registration was measured.

details: The two people, light clothing, green field, pale sky, and close framing are visibly retained in the inspected A8 samples.
No selected A8 frame is black, blank, or affected by a gross geometric collapse.
These observations do not establish full-video visual quality, subtle hand/face fidelity, absence of flicker, or audio quality.

experiment_implication: This formal dense A run is already a negative reversal result. If B or C also fails this sample, that alone cannot attribute the reversal failure to sparse attention. A temporal-success comparison needs a dense baseline that actually performs the intended temporal edit, or must explicitly report all methods' failures.
limits: Nine sampled states provide strong evidence against whole-clip reversal here, but no continuous playback, optical-flow metric, or per-frame motion-direction analysis was performed.
The reversed source column consists only of diagnostic still-image index selection. It is not a newly generated target video or an officially provided ground-truth edit.
No audio listening or speech inference was performed; the source is silent and the generated A8 contains an audio stream that remains unreviewed.
No VLM, new model, remote operation, or package installation was used.
Only this run's visual_review directory was created; formal videos, request/result/status files, and production code remain unchanged.
This review does not measure or validate latency, DiT time, memory, or speedup.
concise_conclusion_zh: 倒放 A 的正式输出未完成整段倒放：九个抽样状态都沿 source 正序，先面对面靠近/接触，后贴胸拥抱，末尾仍是拥抱中望向镜头。真正倒放应从最后的拥抱起，回到开头面对面；A 的起止状态和事件先后均与此相反。画面可用不代表编辑成功，不能把这次 dense A 当作成功倒放基线；未连续播放，不断言每个细小动作或全程质量。
